amendments.change: Locked the archive acquisition, seven-case manifest, workbook header mapping, evaluator, and runner after inspecting only TAR/ZIP member names, workbook sheet/header strings, formulas, and the three-page publisher explanation.
amendments.basis: The publisher explanation identifies five ambient and two cryogenic runs, two files per experiment, synchronized vessel pressure and three in-vessel temperature channels. The 200 bar ambient SE filename differs by two seconds from its PFast case identifier and is mapped prospectively.

objective: Independently evaluate the revised non-adiabatic source-depletion model against open-jet ignited DisCha experiments not used in model development.
claim_boundary: The holdout concerns pressure depletion of the 2.8 L DisCha source vessel during an open atmospheric jet, including the downstream-ignition condition represented in E5.1. It does not validate combustion overpressure, heat flux, flame length, cryogenic two-phase flow, a vehicle-fueling loop, or station emergency separation distance.

source.title: PRESLHY Experiment series E5.1 (Ignited Discharge) results – Benchmarking
source.published_domain: 2.7-2.8 L source, 0.5-20 MPa, approximately 80 K and ambient temperature, 1-4 mm nozzles, delayed ignition

independence.limitation: This is external experimental-condition validation with a shared facility, not independent-laboratory replication.

locked_model.parameter_changes_after_freeze: prohibited for the primary holdout result

case_manifest.pressure_member: SE workbook worksheet ending -presV: synchronized Time [s] and Druck_Behalter
case_manifest.temperature_member: same SE workbook worksheet ending -TE: synchronized Time [s] and three Behalter temperature channels

include: published E5.1 benchmark run with finite source-vessel pressure history
initial hydrogen temperature from 280 K through 330 K for the primary ambient subset
initial absolute pressure from 0.5 MPa through 21 MPa
nominal circular nozzle diameter from 1 mm through 4 mm
at least 20 finite, strictly time-ordered source-pressure samples after release onset
exclude: cryogenic runs from the primary ambient decision; report separately as transfer tests
records without a recoverable source-pressure basis or release-onset signal
duplicate exports of the same physical run
files that contain only downstream combustion pressure, radiation, images, or video
eligibility.insufficient_data_policy: If the published benchmark archive does not meet all minimums, label the result ineligible for the aggregate claim and retain every evaluable case as supplementary transfer evidence.

time_and_pressure_basis.release_time_zero: first sustained rise of published release-line pressure PN; use a publisher-synchronised release time only if the metadata explicitly defines the same event
time_and_pressure_basis.evaluation_end: first source-pressure sample at or below 1.05 times measured ambient absolute pressure, otherwise the finite record end
time_and_pressure_basis.source_pressure: published vessel/filling-line absolute pressure after unit and gauge/absolute basis verification
time_and_pressure_basis.initial_pressure: last valid source absolute-pressure sample before release time zero
time_and_pressure_basis.initial_temperature: median valid in-vessel thermocouple readings over the final 0.5 s before release; no ambient substitution in the primary holdout
time_and_pressure_basis.ambient_pressure: published ambient absolute pressure; if absent, 101325 Pa may be substituted only with a flag

ignition_policy.primary_trace_window: retain the complete eligible source-pressure depletion trace, including post-ignition samples
ignition_policy.rationale: The test asks whether an open downstream ignition materially invalidates source-depletion prediction. Removing post-ignition data after seeing outcomes would make that question untestable.
ignition_policy.diagnostic_only: Report an ignition-time split when the ignition timestamp is published, but it cannot replace the primary full-trace result.

aggregate_decision.claim_rule: The revised source-depletion claim is supported only if all eligibility minima are met and at least 70 percent of eligible ambient cases pass both primary screens.
aggregate_decision.negative_result_policy: A failed or ineligible result remains archived and prohibits a validated revised-model claim from this dataset.

structural_adapter_policy.allowed_before_numerical_outcome_access: Add only file discovery, header parsing, unit conversion, time synchronisation, and immutable implementation hashes after inspecting filenames and metadata strings.
structural_adapter_policy.required_audit_record: Every amendment must state whether numerical pressure or model outcomes were accessed.
